name: detects_paused_cursor
why: v2.9.0: HANDOFF.md retired — a paused pipeline is a cursor with status: paused; ship-status surfaces it as RESUME

name: no_backlog_hand_edit_instruction
why: v3.6.0 wave 2 binding resolution: ship-status stays read-only — Check 7 surfaces the recommendation instead of hand-Editing BACKLOG.md.

name: backlog_size_check_points_at_ship_backlog_archive
why: v3.6.0 wave 2: Check 7's BACKLOG.md-oversize remediation now tells the user to run /ship-backlog archive rather than mutating BACKLOG.md itself.

name: uses_lock_status
why: v3.7.0 wave 3: File Hygiene's skill-mutex rendering reads both lock files in one call via shipyard-data lock status instead of hand-parsing JSON.

name: uses_lock_release_force
why: v3.7.0 wave 3: stale/user-confirmed lock clearing routes through shipyard-data lock release --force instead of a hand Write of the cleared sentinel.

name: render_provenance_negation
why: v3.11.0 context-conflation fix: the render-before-ask rule must state the negative — Read results, subagent returns, dossier files, and SendMessage payloads are not 'shown to the user'. Anchors the same phrase check_render_before_ask requires.

name: check1_uses_doctor_cli
why: perf plan fix 3.1/3.2: Check 1 used to Glob every .md under spec/ and Read each one (measured 779 files and growing on one customer project) — now delegates schema validation to the incremental, watermark-gated shipyard-data doctor CLI.

name: check1_no_whole_tree_glob_read
pattern: Use Glob to enumerate every `\.md` file under
why: fix 3.1: the old whole-tree Glob-then-Read-every-file instruction is retired in favor of the doctor CLI's incremental watermark scan.

name: check1_describes_watermark_contract
why: fix 3.1: Check 1 prose must describe the incremental contract — validate files whose mtime exceeds the last clean-validation timestamp, full sweep on demand or on schema-version change.

name: check1_full_sweep_escape_hatch
why: fix 3.1: a full sweep must remain available on demand (manual bulk edit under spec/) or automatically on schema-version mismatch, not just the incremental path.

name: check1_auto_fix_targets_named_file
why: fix 3.1: auto-fix must Edit only the specific file doctor's finding names, not re-scan the whole tree to locate it.
